events.title: John Santos Sextet
events.description: Latin Jazz legend, composer, percussionist and educator John Santos makes his Keys debut with his stellar Sextet. Their remarkable chemistry, original compositions and arrangements, and multiple critically-acclaimed recordings on Santos' Machete Records label (f. 1984) as well as on the Smithsonian Folkways label have earned them Hall of Fame status in the Bay Area and beyond. [...]
